messages.subject: Corporate know-how session: W&I insurance trends (15 April)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

Reminder that the corporate department's lunchtime know-how session on current trends in warranty & indemnity insurance is on 15 April at 12:30 in Room 4.2. Sandwiches provided. Please let me know if you'd like to attend so I can confirm numbers.

Thanks,
Donna
